funded.reason: Each origin assigns tiers using prior observed contract months only. This history ends validation before the 18-month Tier A threshold; missing shop months reduce per-shop history further. Threshold retained.

application.reason: Each origin assigns tiers using prior observed contract months only. This history ends validation before the 18-month Tier A threshold; missing shop months reduce per-shop history further. Threshold retained.

decision_policy: Selection split chooses a model; validation confirms it against trailing_3m; holdout reports performance only and does not select models or interval bounds.

pair.selection_rule: closest adjacent complete actuals within 10%, same available category/model, peer n>=30; lead-match contrast breaks ties

assumptions.current_actual: Only complete three-month contract-observed windows; incomplete windows are null.
assumptions.BAU: Trailing mean of up to three prior observed months or linear trend over six prior observations; no seasonal or causal claim.
assumptions.intervals: Validation residual ranges checked on holdout; descriptive only, never claimed calibrated at 80%.
assumptions.pair: A05: closest adjacent complete actuals within ±10%, same available category/model, minimum peer n=30; observed lead-match contrast breaks ties; unmatched-master shops do not form one pseudo-peer group.

task2_usage: Quantitative potential gaps may use only EVIDENCE_QUALIFIED_BAU; DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY forecasts are excluded.
